card.name: Frequency words before an ongoing schedule
card.fires_on: Words that give a repeat interval, such as weekly, daily, monthly, hourly, every 5 minutes or per year. They appear in treatment, monitoring or mixing instructions, where a duration or end point may follow.

modes.label: Repeat-interval adverb
modes.description: Weekly, monthly, hourly or daily placed before the thing being repeated.
modes.example: perform<< daily>> CBC, platelet, and retic

modes.label: Unit of time after every/each/per
modes.description: A time noun that closes a phrase like every 5 minutes or each week.
modes.example: repeating this each<< week>> for four weeks.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing 'until' (or its Chinese equivalents) to state when the repeated action stops.
card.plain: It marks the spot after 'every week' or 'daily' where the text often goes on to say 'until' something happens.
